== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Trade serves as the universal language used for communication and exchange throughout the galaxy. It is spoken by various sentient species, including members of the [[Karoshan Empire]]'s royal house, and is frequently utilized for business negotiations between major corporations and representatives of diverse cultures. Beyond its role as a linguistic tool, trade encompasses the exchange of tangible commodities—such as technology, raw materials, plants, and specialized goods—as well as the trading of services, information, and even enemies. Economic activities range from large-[[scale]] corporate dealings on luxury cruisers to the scavenging and recycling of junk in specialized colonies. In some instances, trade is used as a strategic method to negotiate the release of hostages or to manage diplomatic tensions.}}
